visualCharacteristics.purpose: Grid of large image cards with a caption area and centered title and text
visualCharacteristics.layout: Horizontal scroll-snap row on mobile, 2-column grid from 600px; an odd last card spans the full width

contentPattern.structure: one row per card: cell 1 = image; cell 2 = title (H3) and description

reuseGuidance: Use for feature/benefit image grids. Add or remove rows freely; an odd count makes the last card full width.
